claim: Make prompt linting testable by materializing repo-resident lint rules (policy-as-code), analogous to governance rule engines like Spectral.
Use schema/structure constraints to prevent missing required sections (structured output principle applied to prompts).
Treat lint + harness as the arbiter (execution-based) rather than narrative; collect metrics and iterate.
Repo-resident constitutions and harness/initializer prompts reduce drift and improve repeatability for agentic coding.
Chain-of-custody framing applies: prompt + lint rules + receipts are governed entities with provenance relationships.
Determinism requires disallowing volatile closures and enforcing stable output shape, similar to eliminating timestamp nondeterminism.
